items.text: San Francisco WR Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis, ribs) did not practice Wednesday and Kyle Shanahan would not commit to him playing.

49ers WR Deebo Samuel (hamstring) is likely to miss Sunday and DE Nick Bosa (calf) did not practice Wednesday; WR Ricky Pearsall is out for the season. Also out of Wednesday practice: CB Upton Stout, S Marques Sigle, DE Mykel Williams, LB Garret Wallow.
Atlanta CB Billy Bowman and LB Divine Deablo did not practice Wednesday; CB A.J. Terrell returned from IR (limited).

adjust.reason: San Francisco is likely without Deebo Samuel, Ricky Pearsall and Nick Bosa, Mike Evans is in doubt, and several defensive starters missed practice. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
